_purpose: Example 'Analysis Profile' upload -- this is the file the Analysis page reads. It defines pivot tables (group-by + aggregation logic) to run against the audited + feature-engineered data. Nothing is computed until a file like this is uploaded to that slot; there is no backend default. Group-by/metric/filterable_columns can be either raw source columns (e.g. 'Carrier', 'Origin', 'Product', 'Serial Number') or feature-engineered ones (e.g. 'Country of Origin', 'Arrival Month', '% In Spec') -- edit freely and re-upload. Every pivot shows ALL data by default; 'filterable_columns' declares which columns the Analysis page renders as interactive slicers (multi-select filter pickers) so the PM can narrow the view at runtime without editing this file.

pivots.name: Shipments by Product & Origin
pivots.description: Counts shipments grouped by Product then by Origin -- slice by Country of Origin, Origin, Carrier, or Product to answer 'how many shipments per product, and which origin shipped them' for any subset.

pivots.name: Carrier Compliance Ranking
pivots.description: All carriers ranked by shipment volume, with average % In Spec alongside -- slice by Country of Origin, Origin, Carrier, or Product to answer 'which carrier is worst for compliance' for any subset (e.g. just a group of growers, or just one country).

pivots.name: Monthly Compliance Trend
pivots.description: % In Spec and shipment volume by arrival month -- slice by Country of Origin, Origin, Carrier, or Product to answer 'for this subset, is compliance improving or worsening as the season/volume ramps up.'

pivots.name: Shipment Mix by Mode of Transportation
pivots.description: What share of shipments moved by each transportation mode -- slice by Country of Origin, Origin, Carrier, or Product to see the mix for any subset.
